rfc1231.title: IEEE 802.5 Token Ring MIB
rfc1231.abstract: This memo defines an experimental portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for use with network management protocols in TCP/IP-based internets.  In particular, this memo defines managed objects used for managing subnetworks which use the IEEE 802.5 Token Ring technology described in 802.5 Token Ring Access Method and Physical Layer Specifications, IEEE Standard 802.5-1989. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1469.title: IP Multicast over Token-Ring Local Area Networks
rfc1469.abstract: This document specifies a method for the transmission of IP multicast datagrams over Token-Ring Local Area Networks. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1513.title: Token Ring Extensions to the Remote Network Monitoring MIB
rfc1513.abstract: This memo defines extensions to the Remote Network Monitoring MIB for managing 802.5 Token Ring networks. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1743.title: IEEE 802.5 MIB using SMIv2
rfc1743.abstract: This memo defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for use with network management protocols in the Internet community.  In particular, it describes managed objects used for managing subnetworks which use the IEEE 802.5 Token Ring technology described in 802.5 Token Ring Access Method and Physical Layer Specifications, IEEE Standard 802.5-1989. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1748.title: IEEE 802.5 MIB using SMIv2
rfc1748.abstract: This memo defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for use with network management protocols in the Internet community.  In particular, it describes managed objects used for managing subnetworks which use the IEEE 802.5 Token Ring technology described in 802.5 Token Ring Access Method and Physical Layer Specifications, IEEE Standard 802.5-1989. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1749.title: IEEE 802.5 Station Source Routing MIB using SMIv2
rfc1749.abstract: This memo defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for use with network management protocols in the Internet community.  In particular, it describes managed objects used by IEEE 802.5 end-stations for managing source routes on a Token Ring network where IEEE source- routing is in use. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc2470.title: Transmission of IPv6 Packets over Token Ring Networks
rfc2470.abstract: This memo specifies the MTU and frame format for transmission of IPv6 packets on Token Ring networks. [STANDARDS-TRACK]
